r: **Mahodaya**, **Mahodaya Shri** ("Nagar Mahodaya Shri" in Mihira Bhoja's time), Kanyakubja
Harsha made **Kannauj** his capital; the chief commercial and political centre shifted from Ujjain to Kannauj on the Ganga
Its holder claimed to be **Samrat of North India** (like Magadha in the Gupta period)
**Gangetic-Doab** farm wealth; **Arabian Sea trade via Gujarat**, bypassing the Arab-held **Indus delta**
**8th–9th century CE** (c. 780 onwards); the prize was **Kannauj, not Ujjain**
Aim of the Palas and Pratiharas
Vatsaraja, Nagabhata II, Mihira Bhoja, Mahendrapala I
Dhruva, Govinda III, Amoghavarsha, Indra III

0.x: The Rashtrakutas fought the **Pratiharas and the Palas** for Kannauj. "Tripartite" = a struggle among three powers; Rashtrakuta **Dhruva** joined the fight; the Gurjara-Pratiharas finally kept Kannauj.
Outside the struggle: **Cholas**, Pallavas, Kalyani Chalukyas, Chauhans, Gahadavalas.
Chronology: Pallava Mahendravarman I → Pala Gopala → Pratihara Bhoja → Chola Parantaka I.

r: The **Pratiharas** (Bhoja, Mahendrapala I), till Mahmud of Ghazni (1018)
All three exhausted; power shifted to **regional kingdoms** – rise of Rajput states such as the **Chandelas** and Chauhans

1.x: **Chandelas** began as **Pratihara feudatories** (early 9th c.); fought the Pratiharas, Palas and Kalachuris of Chedi.

r: **Vatsaraja** takes Kannauj, defeats Dharmapala; **Dhruva** defeats both, takes loot and returns south
**Dharmapala** removes Pratihara nominee **Indrayudha**, installs his puppet **Chakrayudha**; holds a darbar as overlord of the north
Pratihara **Nagabhata II** ousts Chakrayudha and defeats Dharmapala at **Monghyr (Munger)**; **Govinda III** defeats both, then retreats
**Mihira Bhoja**, Mahendrapala I hold Kannauj – empire from the Himalayas to the Narmada
**Indra III** sacks Kannauj, defeating Pratihara **Mahipala I**
**Sanjan plates** (871 CE, Amoghavarsha I) + Radhanpur plates
Nagabhata II beat Chakrayudha and Dharmapala; Nagabhata I repulsed the Arabs
**Election of Gopala** to end **Matsya Nyaya** (law of the jungle)
